In which format should I save it?

-- 
Francesco Del Carratore

messages.subject: [Batman-users] Batman-users Digest, Vol 4, Issue 1
messages.body_plain:
Dear Francesco,

Yes it should work if you edit your table in excel. You should save it 
as .csv
Besides excel, you should be able to edit your metabolite list any text 
editor, as long as you save it in csv.

Regards,

Gon?alo
